name: Refuge
source:
The city of Garrison; a civilisation encased within a gigantic dome that prides itself upon its self-reliance and whose people spend their entire lives within its walls. Barred from any contact with an outside world filled with savage raiders and hopeless scavengers, those fortunate enough to be born within the dome enjoy a life of safety, relative comfort, and strictly-held order.

When a young citizen named Mac and his closest friend Archie are forced to abandon the dome they’ve known their entire life due to a sudden emergency, their one hope for survival lies in the only other nearby settlement; a band of militant hunters living in the underground base referred to as Refuge, commanded by a no-nonsense figure known only by his title of “Captain”.

As the two escapees slowly adjust to the realities of life in the outside world, and learn more about those living in it, Mac begins to question whether returning to the comfort and convenience he’s always known is what he truly wants...

[From [url=https://dolphinsareevil.itch.io/refuge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加里森市；一个被包裹在巨大圆顶内的文明，以其自力更生而自豪，其人民一生都在其围墙内度过。那些有幸出生在圆顶内的人被禁止与充满野蛮掠夺者和绝望拾荒者的外部世界有任何联系，他们享受着安全、相对舒适和严格遵守的秩序的生活。

当一位名叫麦克的年轻公民和他最亲密的朋友阿奇因突发紧急情况被迫放弃他们一生都熟悉的圆顶时，他们生存的唯一希望就在于附近唯一的另一个定居点；一群好战的猎人居住在被称为“避难所”的地下基地，由一位严肃的人物指挥，人们只知道他的头衔是“队长”。

随着两名逃亡者慢慢适应外面世界的生活现实，并更多地了解生活在其中的人们，麦克开始质疑回到他一直以来所知道的舒适和便利是否是他真正想要的……

[来自[url=https://dolphinsareevil.itch.io/refuge]Itch.io[/url]]
